label: New graduate, just starting out
description: Recently graduated, no GDC registration yet, hasn't started ORE. Needs the full picture from English test through to first UK job.

label: Mid-pathway: ORE Part 1 passed
description: Has cleared the written exam and is preparing for the practical/clinical ORE Part 2 assessment.

label: Exams complete, finalizing registration
description: Has passed or is exempt from ORE and needs to complete the formal GDC registration application.
matching_rule_summary: ore_status in (part2_passed, exempt) AND gdc_status != full

label: GDC registered, focused on job search
description: Already holds full GDC registration. Main gap is UK-format CV, job search, and interview readiness.

label: Needs visa sponsorship
description: Add-on profile across any of the above — also needs guidance on finding a sponsoring employer and the Skilled Worker visa route.
